pins.title: White Noise Machine for Athletes: 3 Portable Picks for Noisy Hotel Rooms on Away Trips
pins.subtitle: Door slams, ice machines, HVAC
pins.description: Night before the game and the hotel hallway won't quiet down? A white noise machine doesn't block noise, but its steady sound can make sudden door slams and HVAC clicks stand out less. This guide compares three rechargeable portable picks for away trips: the Yogasleep Rohm for light packers, the SNOOZ Go 2 for fan and brown noise, and the Yogasleep Hushh 2 for parents rooming with young kids. Based on manufacturer specs. Read the full guide. #whitenoisemachine #athletetravel #hotelsleep #awaygames #travelsoundmachine #sleeptips

pins.title: Portable White Noise Machine for Hotel Rooms: Rohm vs SNOOZ Go 2 vs Hushh 2
pins.subtitle: Which one fits your bag?
pins.description: Choosing a portable white noise machine for hotel stays? Yogasleep Rohm: lightest of the three at 3.4 oz, three noise sounds, a strap, no timer, budget tier. SNOOZ Go 2: 12 sounds including brown noise and fan sounds, up to 24 hours of stated battery, USB-C, Bluetooth, mid-range. Yogasleep Hushh 2: up to 34 hours of stated battery, timer, adjustable night light, child lock, budget tier. See the full comparison table in the guide. #whitenoisemachine #portablesoundmachine #hotelsleep #travelsoundmachine #snooz #yogasleep

pins.title: Travel Sound Machine for Tournament Weekends: Sharing a Hotel Room With Teammates or Kids
pins.subtitle: Shared rooms, early call times
pins.description: Sharing a hotel room at a tournament, and not everyone goes to bed at the same time? A small travel sound machine plays a steady sound so hallway traffic and a roommate shifting around stand out less. Pick by your situation: plain white noise in the lightest package, fan or brown noise for a humming air unit, or a timer and adjustable night light for parents with young kids. Place it between the bed and the door so you can still hear your alarm. Read the full guide. #travelsoundmachine #tournamentweekend #teamtravel #hotelsleep #sportsparents #whitenoisemachine

pins.title: Hotel Sleep Kit Checklist for Away Games and Tournaments
pins.subtitle: Pack it, then set up the room
pins.description: Save this hotel sleep kit checklist for your next away trip. Pack: a portable sound machine and its cable, a USB power adapter, a portable blackout shade or contoured sleep mask, binder clips for the curtain gap, painter's tape for standby lights, and reusable earplugs. At check-in: ask for a room away from the elevator and ice machine, put the sound machine between the bed and the door, clip the curtains, tape the brightest standby lights (never cover a smoke detector), and test your alarm with the machine running. Full checklist in the guide. #hotelsleepkit #travelchecklist #athletetravel #awaygames #hotelsleep #packinglist
